ActiveGrant.description: One unexpired grant, as the gateway needs it. Ids, a name and a mode: never a value.

expires_at.description:
`null` when the grant does not expire. The gateway must still refuse it at or after this
time, even while cached.

Agent.description: A registered agent. Never carries its enrollment secret or the secret's hash.

AgentEnrollment.description: The response that shows an enrollment secret, once. No `Debug`.

enrollment_secret.description:
Exchange at `POST /v1/agent-tokens`. Shown only in this response; only its Argon2id
hash is stored, so it cannot be read back. Not a vault secret.

AgentGrant.description:
A grant: the agent may use the named secret in `mode` until `expires_at`. Names and ids
only; never the value.

AgentGrantSet.description: An agent's unexpired grants at the time of the request.

AgentToken.description:
A minted agent token (RFC 6749 section 5.1 shape). No `Debug`: the token is a bearer
credential for the gateway only.

AgentTokenRequest.description: Request body of a token exchange. No `Debug`.

AppendedEvent.description: Where an event landed in the org's chain.

seq.description: The event's sequence number in the org's chain, starting at 1.

AuditCheckpoint.description: The newest signed checkpoint of the org's chain.

digest.description: The chain digest at `seq`, lowercase hex.

key_id.description: Signing key name and version, e.g. `audit-checkpoint:1`.

attrs.description: Identifier-typed attributes (ids, hosts, codes, integers) only.

digest.description: This event's SHA-256 chain digest, lowercase hex.

prev_digest.description: SHA-256 chain digest of the previous event, lowercase hex (64 zeros for `seq` 1).

seq.description: Position in the org's chain, starting at 1 with no gaps.

target.description: `secret:<id>`, `agent:<id>`, `grant:<id>`, ...; absent when the event has no target.

AuditEventPage.description: One page of events, newest first. `next` is absent on the last page.

AuditStatus.description: Chain status of the bound org.

head_seq.description: Seq of the newest event (0 when the org has none).

oneOf.description: Absent until the first checkpoint is signed.
Absent until a verify run has been recorded.

AuditVerifyRun.description: The newest `locksmith-audit verify` run recorded for the org.

broken_seq.description: The first broken seq, when the run failed.

events.description: Events and checkpoints the run walked.

truncated_at.description: Set when the chain ends before the latest checkpoint.

GrantMode.description: How a grant lets the agent use the secret. S4 has relay only.

Jwk.description: One public key in the JWKS (RFC 7517, RFC 8037 `OKP`/`Ed25519`).

kid.description: Key id: the RFC 7638 SHA-256 thumbprint of this key.

x.description: The public key, base64url without padding.

JwkSet.description: The JWK set published at `/.well-known/jwks.json`. Public keys only.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry (RFC 3339, in the future). Omit for no expiry.

secret_id.description: The secret the agent may relay (same org).

NewRelayEvent.description:
One relay event from the gateway. Ids, codes, a host and numbers only: there is no field
for a URL, path, query string, header, body or value.

agent_id.description: The agent whose verified token made the call (the event's actor).

attempt_id.description:
Links the `relay.outcome` event to its `relay.attempt` event (the `id` the attempt's
append returned). Required for `relay.outcome`, and its idempotency key: an outcome
resent for the same attempt returns the stored event instead of appending another.

host.description:
Upstream host name or IP literal only (an IPv6 address in brackets); no port, path or
query.

port.description: Upstream port, when the URL names one explicitly.

secret_id.description: The secret the call used (the event's target).

status.description: Upstream HTTP status, when a response was received.

NewSecretVersion.description: Request body of a version write.

value.description: The secret value (UTF-8). Write-only: no endpoint ever returns it.

Paged_Agent.description: One page of a list. `next` is absent on the last page.

items.description: A registered agent. Never carries its enrollment secret or the secret's hash.

Paged_AgentGrant.description: One page of a list. `next` is absent on the last page.

items.description:
A grant: the agent may use the named secret in `mode` until `expires_at`. Names and ids
only; never the value.

Paged_Environment.description: One page of a list. `next` is absent on the last page.

Paged_Project.description: One page of a list. `next` is absent on the last page.

Paged_Secret.description: One page of a list. `next` is absent on the last page.

version_count.description: Number of stored versions (`POST .../versions` adds one).

Patch.description: `PATCH` body for projects, environments and secrets: name and description only.

Problem.description: The JSON body of an error response.

RelayEventKind.description: The kind of a relay event.

RelayOutcome.description: The outcome of a relay event (the gateway's outcome codes, plus `pending` for an attempt).

version_count.description: Number of stored versions (`POST .../versions` adds one).

SecretVersion.description: Metadata of one stored version. Never carries the value or any key material.

key_id.description: The KMS key the version's data key is wrapped under, e.g. `gateway:v1`.

SecretVersionList.description: All versions of a secret, oldest first.

SecretVersionMaterial.description:
The stored envelope of one secret version. Ciphertext and a wrapped data key only: never the
value, and never an unwrapped key.

ciphertext.description: A0-7 ciphertext blob (header, nonce, ciphertext, tag), standard base64 with padding.

key_id.description: The KMS key the data key is wrapped under, e.g. `gateway:v1`.

wrapped_dek.description: A0-7 `dek-wrap` blob (the KMS-wrapped data key), standard base64 with padding.

dev_org.description: Dev-only org binding, honoured only with LOCKSMITH_DEV_AUTH=1.
dev_org.name: x-locksmith-dev-org

service_token.description: Gateway service token (LOCKSMITH_GATEWAY_SERVICE_TOKEN); the org is named in the X-Locksmith-Org header.

info.description: Orgs, projects, environments, secret metadata, write-only secret versions, agents and their grants. A secret value can be written to a new version; no endpoint ever returns a value. An agent's enrollment secret is returned once, when it is created or rotated.

post.description: The gateway appends `relay.attempt` before any key unwrap and refuses the call when this fails, `relay.outcome` after the upstream call, and `relay.denied` for a refused call. Unknown fields, kinds, outcomes and methods are a `400`; so is a host with a port, path or query. `relay.outcome` needs `attempt_id` and is idempotent on it: resending the same outcome returns the stored event with `200`, and a different outcome for the same attempt is a `409`.

parameters.description: The org the event belongs to (the agent token's `org`)
